# 🤖 AI & ML Portfolio Website

A sleek, dark theme portfolio website with modern animations and bold visuals — ideal for a final year Computer Science student specializing in AI and Machine Learning, designed to impress recruiters and technical hiring managers.

---

## 🎯 Objective

Create a high impact, recruiter focused portfolio website that clearly communicates:

- Strong foundation in Machine Learning and AI systems  
- Production level engineering experience  
- Research oriented mindset  
- Open source contributions  
- Competitive performance in data science competitions  

The design should feel modern, intelligent, and technically sophisticated while remaining clean and professional.

---

## 🎨 Design Direction

- Dark futuristic theme with neon accent colors (electric blue, cyan, subtle purple glow)  
- Clean modern typography with a tech inspired aesthetic  
- Subtle animated grid, neural network, or circuit style background  
- Floating code fragments, vector embeddings, or AI inspired visuals  
- Fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile  
- Smooth scrolling and fluid motion throughout  

---

## 🧭 Navigation

- Sticky top navigation bar  
- Smooth scroll to sections  
- Active section highlighting  
- Mobile friendly hamburger menu  
- Back to top button  

---

## 📄 Pages & Sections

### 1️⃣ Hero Section

- Animated intro headline with typing effect:  
  > "Hi, I'm [Your Name] — AI Engineer & Machine Learning Researcher"

- Subheadline emphasizing:
  - Building production ready ML systems  
  - Autonomous AI agents  
  - High performance ML infrastructure  

- Two primary call to action buttons:
  - View Projects  
  - Download Resume  

- Background animation:  
  - Subtle particle field, neural graph animation, or dynamic gradient  

---

## ✨ Visual Effects & Motion

- Scroll triggered fade and slide animations  
- Interactive hover lift effects on project cards  
- Soft glow effects on skill icons  
- Animated gradient or neural mesh in hero section  
- Smooth micro interactions throughout  

Keep animations refined and professional, not flashy.

---

## ⚙️ Technical Implementation Requirements

- Built with React or Next.js  
- Styled using Tailwind CSS  
- Framer Motion for animations  
- Optional Three.js or Canvas for neural style background  
- SEO optimized  
- Fast loading and performance optimized  
- Clean folder structure and scalable component architecture  

---

## 🧠 Tone & Messaging

The overall tone should communicate:

- Technical depth  
- Engineering maturity  
- Research driven thinking  
- Production readiness  
- Leadership capability  

The final website should feel like a polished AI engineer portfolio ready for top tier startups, research labs, and ML focused companies.
